Specification: Byzantine broadcast protocol with TLAPS machine-checked proofs. Models correct and faulty processes, ECHO message sending with threshold guards based on N, T, F parameters, and proves unforgeability (no correct process accepts if all correct processes propose V0) via an inductive invariant. Extends multiple standard library modules for finite set and function reasoning.
